entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3 16-04-2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence under Sections 342, 365,
366A, 376, 323 of the Indian Penal Code and U/s 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, petitioner is said to have committed rape upon a minor girl.
Material have come during investigation to connect the petitioner with the crime.

4. Considering the gravity and nature of offence, I Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.8884 of 2024(3)
dt.16-04-2024 am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
5. This application for regular bail is dismissed.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Shishir/-
